g.text: Donor-level classifier reports high internal AUC
Q0 Can this be answered with these data?
a collection stratum holds both labels, AND the recorded
metadata does not separate the labels exactly
Q1 Does the pipeline beat the free permutation?
labels permuted freely, whole pipeline refitted
Q2 Does it beat the collection-preserving permutation?
labels permuted within collection strata only
Q3 Is the metadata-diagnosis link weak?
design-only AUC near chance and not beyond its own null
Q4 Is a collection stratum large enough to restrict to?
Q5 Do restriction and residualisation agree?
EXIT GATE · external target collected a different way
CANNOT BE ANSWERED
No collection stratum holds both labels, or the metadata
separates them exactly. → no claim of any kind.
NO SIGNAL
The observed AUC lies inside its own null.
→ nothing to adjust or attribute.
CONSISTENT WITH THE COLLECTION STRATA
Accuracy does not exceed what the strata alone produce.
→ separability only.
ROUTE A · WEAK NUISANCE
Little to remove. Adjust only with its cost reported:
a wide design matrix takes accuracy away regardless.
ROUTE C · REDESIGN
No stratum is large enough to restrict within. Escalate
to a crossed-design cohort. → separability only.
ROUTE B1 · CONCORDANT
The choice of adjustment is not driving the conclusion.
ROUTE B2 · DISCORDANT
Report both estimates. They are NOT bounds on a biological effect.
